title: Templars, Lalibela and the Ark in Ethiopia

tellings.quote: I speculated that he tipped the Templars off that the Ark of the Covenant was in Ethiopia

plain: The Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest from the Bible, ended up in Ethiopia, and in the Middle Ages someone tipped off the Knights Templar, the order of crusader knights based at the Temple Mount in Jerusalem, that it was there, in a story linked to Lalibela in Ethiopia. The writer Graham Hancock tells Michels this as his own speculation, from his book The Sign and the Seal: "I speculated that he tipped the Templars off that the Ark of the Covenant was in Ethiopia." If true, it would mean the Templars knew where the lost Ark was hidden.
